properties.name: Mammoth Cave National Park
properties.description: Mammoth Cave is the longest known cave system in the world; the National Park Service reports 426 miles surveyed. The park lies mainly in Edmonson County, with small areas in Hart and Barren counties. Saltpeter was mined here for gunpowder during the War of 1812, and Salts Cave inside the park was mined by Indigenous people. The pin marks the NPS visitor center, where cave tours start.

properties.name: Great Onyx Cave
properties.description: Great Onyx Cave is inside Mammoth Cave National Park. The National Park Service offers a lantern tour of the cave.

properties.name: Hidden River Cave
properties.description: Hidden River Cave lies under the town of Horse Cave. It has underground rivers and the remains of an old hydroelectric plant, and is home to the American Cave Museum. Address: 119 East Main Street, Horse Cave.

properties.name: Diamond Caverns
properties.description: Diamond Caverns in Park City was discovered on July 14, 1859, and is a show cave open for tours. Address: 1900 Mammoth Cave Parkway, Park City.

photo.title: Travertine drapery, Diamond Caverns
photo.attribution: James St. John · Wikimedia Commons · CC BY 2.0

properties.name: Onyx Cave
properties.description: Onyx Cave in Cave City is a show cave offering 30-minute tours, known for its cave coral. Address: 93 Huckleberry Knob Road, Cave City.

photo.title: Flowstone, Onyx Cave
photo.attribution: James St. John · Wikimedia Commons · CC BY 2.0

properties.name: Lost River Cave
properties.description: Lost River Cave in Bowling Green is a seven-mile cave system with one of the largest natural entrances in the eastern United States. Boat tours run year-round. Address: 2818 Nashville Road, Bowling Green.

properties.name: Carter Caves State Resort Park
properties.description: Carter Caves State Resort Park along Tygarts Creek offers guided cave tours. Its caves include Saltpeter Cave (NRHP 2001, mined for niter by the early 1800s) and Cascade Caverns. Bat Cave and Cascade Caverns have been state nature preserves since 1981; Bat Cave protects wintering Indiana bats (about 28,000). The pin marks the park, not a cave entrance.

properties.name: Great Saltpetre Cave
properties.description: Great Saltpetre Cave was an important source of saltpeter for gunpowder during the War of 1812. It was listed on the National Register of Historic Places in 2013 and lies within the Daniel Boone National Forest.

properties.name: Barren County caves
properties.description: Caves are documented in Barren County. This marker sits at the county centre and is not a cave location. Exact cave locations are protected and held by the Kentucky Speleological Survey (KSS); researchers can request access through the KSS Data Request Form.
